data.title: 圣路易斯 · 豪华跑车驾驶座的午夜回眸
data.description: 都会沿海公路旁的观景休息区，敞篷跑车停在海崖边。圣路易斯身穿一袭紧身露肩深蓝礼服裙坐在驾驶席上，冰蓝色的长发在夜风中轻扬。她单手搭在真皮方向盘上，另一只手优雅地托着下巴，后方是如梦似幻的繁华夜城霓虹。紫色眸子深情凝视，向你展现出香车美人的极致都市魅力。
data.action: seated in open convertible sports car, fitted off-shoulder cocktail dress, blue hair blowing in night coastal wind, hand resting on steering wheel, seductive glamorous gaze
data.location: convertible sports car interior parked at scenic coastal night overlook
data.lighting: vibrant city neon and dashboard LED lights illuminating luxury car and dress
data.mood: high-end metropolitan glamour, thrilling romantic sophistication
data.promptProse: Sitting in the driver seat of a sleek convertible overlooking a glowing nocturnal bay, St. Louis wears an off-shoulder navy cocktail dress. Her long blue hair flutters in the sea breeze as she looks back with a glamorous, captivating smile.
data.animaCaption: St. Louis sitting in a convertible sports car at night in an off-shoulder dress, smiling alluringly.
